She then reaches for the black smartphone lying in the foreground, picking it up with precise, economical gestures. She tilts the dark, reflective screen toward her face to scrutinize her coral lipstick. The depth of field performs a subtle, slow shift from the phone screen to <Subject 1>'s face. She lowers the phone slightly, and a satisfied, composed grin spreads across her features as she looks directly into the camera.
